# CANDIDATE: LIVE_PRICE_FIRST_BAR_TRIGGER_LESS_LAG

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** trigger_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The LIVE_PRICE_FIRST_BAR_TRIGGER currently waits for a confirmation qualifier (e.g., price closing beyond premarket high/low) that adds lag, causing missed early entry opportunities on J's anchor days. Removing or reducing this qualifier would allow earlier entry while maintaining edge, as the premarket level break itself is the primary signal.

## Mechanism

Current design: Wait for premarket high (for longs) or low (for shorts) to be established, then require a confirming bar (e.g., close beyond level) before entry.  
Proposed design: Enter at the open of the first RTH bar that trades beyond the premarket level (i.e., break of premarket high/low) without waiting for bar-close confirmation. Use intrabar breach as trigger, with stop placed at the opposite premarket level plus buffer.
